claim: Run 2 validly establishes a bounded-memory advantage over competent conventional systems.

invalidators.requirement: The exact structured baseline must exploit the existing entity/field/update and utility structure available to a competent indexed store.
invalidators.observed: The implementation indexed only the 64-way normalized A/B address and creation episode, omitting entity, field, supersession, salience, and active-scope utility. Irrelevant records that reused an address were therefore treated as valid temporal versions.
invalidators.effect: Exact structured answer accuracy fell from 1.0 at load 64 to 0.113636 at load 1024 for a representation-induced reason, not a conventional-memory limitation.

invalidators.requirement: A bounded-memory advantage cannot be declared when any included simple conventional system matches capability and is no worse on the relevant bounded resources.
invalidators.observed: The mechanical bounded-advantage gate checked only exact_structured and conventional_retrieval. It did not check recent_window_16, which achieved 1.0 answer accuracy at every history size with 16 persistent and 16 query-working records.
invalidators.effect: The emitted terminal state is not implied by the full baseline table.

invalidators.requirement: For externally persisted systems with bounded retrieval, critical recall is target presence in the bounded retrieved candidate set.
invalidators.observed: exact_structured counted the target anywhere in all persistent index buckets while reporting only the selected record as its bounded candidate set.
invalidators.effect: Its reported critical recall remained 1.0 even when retrieval selected the wrong record.

dmc_retrieval_all_history.interpretation: The frozen learned retriever cannot disambiguate utility-irrelevant records that alias a relevant A/B address when learned retention is removed.

authorized_correction_scope: Use the existing explicit active-scope, salience, entity, field, and supersession metadata to build competent conventional indexes without target IDs, answers, oracle views, or case IDs.
Count bounded critical recall at the retrieved-candidate boundary.
Compact conventional retained records to the fields actually required after ingestion and count every persisted record/index byte.

Evaluate conventional dominance across every included conventional baseline, including recent_window_16, using capability, persistent bytes, bounded working bytes, query work, total online wall time, and zero training.
Do not alter DMC, cases, thresholds, training accounting, all-history scorer adapter, or result values from prior runs.
